description: Free tier: limited to a small daily quota per client. Screens one person or entity name against the combined OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated and UN Consolidated lists using a 4-tier match pipeline (exact / alias / fuzzy / fuzzy-alias). Returns ranked candidates with match_type, confidence and scoring breakdown. Price beyond the free quota: $0.002 per call, paid via x402 in USDC on Base.

query_name.description: Person or entity name to screen

threshold.description: Optional fuzzy match threshold, 0.0-1.0. Defaults to 0.8.

name: screen_name
title: Screen a name against all lists
